name: Force of Presence
text: Add the rolled total to a Presence roll, or make a single NPC of lesser standing yield a minor concession with no roll. What they yield, they yield in front of witnesses.

name: Read the Table
text: In any negotiation, learn each present NPC's true priority and which of them will break first.

name: Common Ground
text: Bridge a cultural divide instantly; treat a stranger as a known contact for the scene.

name: The Ledger Remembers
text: Add the rolled total to a roll that leverages who owes whom, or surface a true obligation an NPC is bound by. Either way, the obligation becomes established fact; the debt outlives the scene.

name: Leverage
text: Produce a piece of usable leverage on a target you have had time to study. One use.

name: Field Improvisation
text: Restore Hull, gear durability, or Armor Slots by the rolled total without a workshop, or assemble a single-use device the scene calls for.

name: Hot-Wire
text: Bypass or activate any non-Precursor lock, system, or machine with no roll, loudly and temporarily.

name: Ghost in the Logs
text: Add the rolled total to a network or intrusion roll, or read a system’s recent log of activity. The intrusion is attributed to whoever you choose.

name: Safe Handling
text: When handling a Precursor artifact, suppress one of its hazardous effects for the scene.

name: Stabilize
text: Clear HP marks from a downed or wounded ally equal to the rolled total. Field medicine, not magic.

name: Find a Way
text: There is always a route. Discover a viable path through terrain, a blockade, or a sealed approach.

name: Read the Ground
text: Learn the chief hazard and one resource or landmark of unfamiliar terrain before crossing.

name: Perfect Recall of Place
text: In any place you have mapped, add the rolled total to a relevant roll, and you never lose your way.

name: Endure
text: You and the crew ignore one environmental hazard—heat, toxin, or an exposure window—for a meaningful stretch.

name: Run It Down
text: When tracking or pursuing, add the rolled total; on a hit, close to your quarry. Your quarry now knows it is hunted.

name: Calibrated Minor Ritual
text: Spend 10 uninterrupted minutes performing a documented group procedure. Roll one Resolve Die. Choose Group Calibration, Group Adaptation, or Sustained Restoration for willing creatures up to your level + Spellcast Trait modifier, minimum one. The ritual lasts a number of hours equal to the die result; a creature can benefit from only one of your rituals at a time.

name: Uncanny Power
text: Roll one Effort Die for each Resolve spent and add your Spellcast Trait once. The Keeper gains 1 Fear per Resolve spent. The result sets the maximum unlocked Domain Power level you may attempt with a Knowledge Spellcast Roll against DC 10 + the Power level. On a Critical Success, regain the Resolve spent.

name: Never Tell Me the Odds
text: When a maneuver is called impossible or the odds are quoted, declare a permanent quirk of the hull that makes it possible. Roll with Advantage; on a roll with Fear, the ship pays, not the crew.

name: Hold Together
text: Reduce the damage your ship takes this round by the rolled total, or keep a failing system online.

name: Lose the Tail
text: Break pursuit or a sensor lock; vanish into traffic, debris, or a route only you know.

name: Gun Run
text: Add the rolled total to a ship-weapon attack; on a hit, it lands one threshold band higher.

name: Reroute Power
text: This round, push one ship system—engines, weapons, or shields—past its rated limit.

name: Analyze Weakness
text: Study a foe or object and reveal a vulnerability that grants the crew Advantage against it for the scene.

name: I Have Read About This
text: Add the rolled total to any Knowledge roll, and declare one true, useful fact into the scene.

name: Know the Beast
text: Learn a creature’s behavior, diet, threat pattern, and one weakness.

name: Dig-Site Discipline
text: Add the rolled total to a roll to safely excavate, date, or disarm a Vault feature. Your markers remain; the next team through follows them safely.

name: Signal in the Noise
text: Extract the true message from corrupted data, propaganda, or a flood of intel.

name: Vanish
text: Break line of sight and leave a tense scene with no roll, to reappear where it will hurt them most.

name: The Long Con
text: Plant a false belief or forged credential that holds up under one round of scrutiny.

name: Killing Window
text: Against an unaware or marked target, add the rolled total to the strike, and it lands one threshold band higher.

name: Never Was Here
text: Erase your presence from a scene after the fact: records, witnesses’ certainty, and sensor traces.

name: False Bottom
text: Produce a small forbidden item you had stashed, or hide one from a search.

name: Take the Hit
text: When an ally within Close range is hit, intercept the attack. Reduce the damage by the rolled total and take any remaining damage yourself.

name: Disciplined Strike
text: Add the rolled total to a damage roll. The target cannot spend Armor Slots against the added portion of this damage.

name: Bulwark
text: Grant one ally within Close range Armor Slots equal to the rolled total until the end of the scene. Unspent granted slots vanish when the scene ends.

name: Order the Line
text: Choose one ally who can hear you. They immediately move one range band or make one attack outside their Spotlight. This does not consume their Reaction.

name: Stand Down
text: Add the rolled total to a roll made to disarm, restrain, or de-escalate without killing. Word spreads that you ended it without blood.

name: The Weightless Art
text: For the rolled total in rounds, your ki makes the world your floor: walls, water, cables, and the heads of a crowd. You fall without sound or harm, and your leaps cross one additional range band. This is motion, never flight.

name: Falling Star
text: Close one range band, descending or leaping if the approach allows it, and attack. Add the rolled total to the damage. If you arrived from above, the strike deals your branch damage type and treats the target’s Major and Severe Thresholds as 4 lower for this hit. This penetration never stacks with the damage type’s own.

name: Stillness
text: Until your next Spotlight, you cannot be targeted by an attack that requires seeing you. You are simply not where the eye expects.

name: Shockwave
text: Your next Melee hit adds the rolled total to its damage. Then move the target one range band directly away from you or apply Prone.

name: Burning Focus
text: Until your next Spotlight, you shed light nothing can hide from. Enemies within Close range cannot benefit from Hidden against you.
